C1854.title: FTC Settled with Plaid over Financial Account Aggregation Data-Collection Dispute
keywords: FTC Settled with Plaid over Financial Account Aggregation Data-Collection Dispute
C1854.summary: In January 2021, the U.S. Federal Trade Commission announced a settlement with financial technology company Plaid. The FTC alleged that when Plaid connected consumer bank accounts through third-party apps, it used misleading interfaces and collected financial data beyond what some consumers expected. The settlement required Plaid to disclose the scope of data collection, limit data retention, and delete unnecessary data, illustrating credential and data-control risks from third-party account aggregation.
